root type is immutable; permissions update request observed
admin route gate, API-key authentication, and cross-user key deletion measured empirically
any selected-tag overlap grants tag access when selectedTagsNotAccessible is false
explicit item blocked when canAccessExplicitContent is false; allowed to root
only permitted libraries/items visible; Node/Go observed equal

limitations: RSS fixture and audio scan require local ffmpeg and Node fetch support.
